<poml>
  <meta>
    <title>Arzansite Backend API Guide (Frontend Integration)</title>
    <version>2025-09-04</version>
    <audience>Frontend engineers</audience>
    <notes>All endpoints are under the NestJS backend. Auth is JWT-based, with Appwrite-backed identity. Roles via Appwrite labels.</notes>
  </meta>

  <stylesheet>
    role { tone: "practical"; }
    task { format: "bullets"; }
    table { compact: true; }
    example { format: "json"; }
    img, document { display: "collapsed"; }
  </stylesheet>

  <role>You are implementing the frontend for login/membership, orders and payments, wallet, uploads, notifications, analytics, profiles, invoices/receipts, and admin tools against this backend.</role>

  <let name="baseUrl">{{ env.API_BASE_URL || "https://api.arzansite.com" }}</let>
  <let name="authHeader">Authorization: Bearer &lt;access_token&gt;</let>

  <section id="auth">
    <task>Authentication and membership flows</task>
    <note>Guards: JwtGuard for protected routes; RolesGuard for admin; AppwriteAuthGuard only on /auth/userinfo</note>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Method</th><th>Path</th><th>Body/Query</th><th>Auth</th><th>Purpose</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/signup</td><td>SignUpDto { email, password, metadata? }</td><td>None</td><td>Create user; optionally sends verification email</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/verify-email</td><td>{ token, user_id? }</td><td>None</td><td>Verify email via custom token</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/password-reset</td><td>{ email }</td><td>None</td><td>Send password reset email</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/reset-password</td><td>{ token, newPassword | new_password, email? }</td><td>None</td><td>Reset password (token from email)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/request-verification</td><td>{ email, password }</td><td>None</td><td>Request verification email after login</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/auth/check-verification/:email</td><td>-</td><td>None</td><td>Check if email verified</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/login</td><td>SignInDto { email, password }</td><td>None</td><td>Login; returns access_token, refresh_token, session</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/login-with-jwt</td><td>{ email, jwt }</td><td>None</td><td>Exchange Appwrite JWT for backend tokens</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/refresh</td><td>{ refresh_token }</td><td>None</td><td>Get new access_token</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/logout</td><td>-</td><td>JWT</td><td>Logout; deletes Appwrite session if present</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/auth/me</td><td>-</td><td>JWT</td><td>Get current user id and role</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/session</td><td>{ jwt }</td><td>None</td><td>Validate Appwrite JWT; sets httpOnly cookie appwrite_jwt</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/userinfo</td><td>-</td><td>AppwriteAuthGuard (Bearer Appwrite JWT)</td><td>Get user info using Appwrite JWT</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/exchange-jwt</td><td>{ appwriteJwt }</td><td>None</td><td>Appwrite JWT → backend JWTs</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/session-auth</td><td>{ session_id+email | email+password }</td><td>None</td><td>Authenticate with Appwrite session</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/session-logout</td><td>{ session_id }</td><td>None</td><td>Logout Appwrite session id</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/auth/session-info/:session_id</td><td>-</td><td>None</td><td>Get session info and user</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/session-validate</td><td>{ session_id }</td><td>None</td><td>Validate session status</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/oauth/:provider/start</td><td>{ successUrl, failureUrl }</td><td>None</td><td>Initiate OAuth (github/google...)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/oauth/:provider/callback</td><td>{ user_id, secret }</td><td>None</td><td>Handle OAuth callback; sets cookies</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/auth/oauth/providers</td><td>-</td><td>None</td><td>List enabled OAuth providers</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/auth/oauth/me</td><td>-</td><td>Cookie appwrite_session</td><td>Get current user from OAuth session</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/auth/oauth/logout</td><td>-</td><td>Cookie</td><td>Clear OAuth and backend session cookies</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <example title="Login">
{
  "method": "POST",
  "url": "{{ baseUrl }}/auth/login",
  "body": { "email": "user@example.com", "password": "Secret123!" },
  "response": {
    "access_token": "...",
    "refresh_token": "...",
    "user": { "id": "user_x", "email": "user@example.com", "emailVerified": true, "role": "user" }
  }
}
    </example>

    <document title="Frontend notes">
- Send `{{ authHeader }}` on protected APIs.
- Roles from Appwrite labels: presence of "admin" → role=admin; else user.
- JwtGuard also accepts httpOnly cookie `appwrite_jwt` (set by /auth/session).
    </document>
  </section>

      <tbody>

        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/me/transactions</td><td>CreateTransactionDto</td><td>JWT</td><td>Create transaction (credit/debit)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/me/deposit</td><td>WalletDepositDto</td><td>JWT</td><td>Initiate deposit via ZarinPal</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/me/deposit/verify</td><td>{ authority }</td><td>JWT</td><td>Verify deposit after payment</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/deposit/callback</td><td>{ authority, refId, amount, user_id, order_id? }</td><td>None</td><td>Gateway callback (idempotent)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/deposit/verify-with-gateway</td><td>{ authority, amount, user_id, order_id? }</td><td>None</td><td>Verify with gateway then credit (idempotent)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/me/topup</td><td>{ amount, refId }</td><td>JWT</td><td>Top up via verified RefId</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/refund-order</td><td>{ order_id }</td><td>JWT</td><td>Refund order to wallet</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/:user_id/credit</td><td>{ amount, description? }</td><td>JWT+Admin</td><td>Admin credit user wallet</td></tr>
        <tr><td>POST</td><td>/wallets/:user_id/debit</td><td>{ amount, description? }</td><td>JWT+Admin</td><td>Admin debit user wallet</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/wallets/:user_id</td><td>-</td><td>JWT+Admin</td><td>Admin get wallet</td></tr>
        <tr><td>GET</td><td>/wallets/:user_id/transactions</td><td>?limit? offset?</td><td>JWT+Admin</td><td>Admin list transactions</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>

  <section id="guards-and-authz">
    <task>Guards and how frontend should authenticate</task>
    <document title="Guards">
- JwtGuard: Accepts Authorization Bearer backend JWT or cookie appwrite_jwt; if backend JWT invalid, falls back to Appwrite JWT validation.
- RolesGuard: Requires @Roles('admin') to pass; role derived from Appwrite user labels (contains "admin" → admin).
- AppwriteAuthGuard: Only on /auth/userinfo; expects Appwrite JWT; attaches user to req.
    </document>
    <document title="Frontend auth flow">
- Preferred: Use /auth/login → store access_token (short) + refresh_token; pass access_token in Authorization.
- If using Appwrite on frontend, you can exchange session JWT via /auth/exchange-jwt or set session cookie via /auth/session for server-managed httpOnly cookie.
- For OAuth: start via /auth/oauth/:provider/start; complete via backend callback that sets cookies; then call /auth/oauth/me.
    </document>
  </section>

  <section id="dtos">
    <task>Key DTO shapes (abbreviated)</task>
    <example title="SignUpDto">
{ "email": "user@example.com", "password": "Secret123!", "metadata": { "name": "John Doe" } }
    </example>
    <example title="CreateOrderDto (orders)">
{ "title": "Site order", "description": "Business site", "total_amount": 5000000, "payment_status": "pending", "wizard_data": { "pricing": { "totalPrice": 5000000 } } }
    </example>
    <example title="WalletDepositDto">
{ "amount": 3000000, "description": "شارژ کیف پول" }
    </example>
    <example title="PaymentRequestDto">
{ "order_id": "order_x", "amount": 5000000, "description": "Order payment", "callback_url": "https://app.arzansite.com/pay/callback" }
    </example>
    <example title="CreateInvoiceDto">
{ "order_id": "order_x", "amount": 5000000, "dueDate": "2025-09-30T00:00:00.000Z", "description": "Order invoice" }
    </example>
  </section>

  <section id="utils">
    <task>Field mapping and casing</task>
    <document title="Field casing">
- The backend stores Appwrite documents with snake_case. Some controllers serialize JSON fields (e.g., wizard_data as JSON string); frontend should treat metadata fields defensively and parse if needed.
- Reference `src/common/utils/field-mapper.util.ts` for mapping helper semantics (snake_case vs camelCase).
    </document>
  </section>

  <section id="response-shapes-and-errors">
    <task>Common response patterns</task>
    <document>
- Success: JSON objects containing `message`, domain object(s), and identifiers; payments return `authority`, `paymentUrl`, or `refId`.
- Errors: 400 BadRequest for validation; 401 Unauthorized for auth; 403 Forbidden for role; 404 NotFound.
- Email verification failure messages are user-friendly strings (e.g., link used, expired).
    </document>
  </section>

  <section id="security-and-cookies">
    <task>Cookie behaviors</task>
    <document>
- Backend may set httpOnly `appwrite_jwt` via /auth/session and `appwrite_session` and `user_info` via OAuth callback.
- Production cookies set SameSite=None; domain: `.arzansite.com`; secure true.
- Prefer Authorization header from SPA; cookie path mainly for OAuth bridge and SSR contexts.
    </document>
  </section>

}

## Summary

I've fixed the phone number requirement issue in your signup process. Here's what was wrong and how I fixed it:

### The Problem
- **Appwrite SDK v13+** requires a phone parameter in the `users.create()` method
- Your backend was only passing `ID.unique()`, `email`, `password`, and `name`
- This caused the error: `"Invalid 'phone' param: Phone number must start with a '+' can have a maximum of fifteen digits"`

### The Fix
I updated `src/appwrite/appwrite.service.ts` to include an empty string as the phone parameter:

```typescript
const user = await this.users.create(
  ID.unique(),
  email,
  password,
  name,
  '', // phone - empty string as default since it's required by SDK
);
```

### What This Means for Your Frontend
- **No changes needed** - your frontend can continue using just email and password for signup
- The phone number requirement is now handled automatically by the backend
- Users can still optionally provide a phone number in the `metadata` field if needed

### Complete Integration Guide
I've also created a comprehensive `frontend-integration-guide.json` file that includes:
- All API endpoints with proper request/response examples
- Authentication flows (signup, login, verification)
- Troubleshooting section for common issues
- Complete example flows for signup, login, and wallet operations

### Test the Fix
Try your signup request again with just email and password:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.arzansite.com/auth/signup \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"test@example.com","password":"Secret123!"}'
```

The phone number error should now be resolved!
